Name: NPC Victoria - Just Visiting - Rupnan's Collection
Author: Rupnan
Description:
[quote][b]VICTORIA - CHARACTER OVERVIEW[/b][/quote]
Victoria is a brilliant university student from Zuzu City who arrives in Pelican Town to enjoy a well-deserved vacation and keep company with her close friend from college, Aurelian.

[quote][b]GENERAL INFORMATION[/b][/quote][list]
[*]Origin: Zuzu City[/*]
[*]Occupation: Higher Education Student / Academic Researcher[/*]
[*]Temporary Residence: Abigail's Room (Pierre's General Store)[/*]
[*]Role: Custom NPC with seasonal dialogues, dynamic routines, personalized quests, and heart events.
[quote][b]PERSONALITY & TRAITS[/b][/quote][/*]
[*]Victoria stands out for her analytical, sharp, and highly observant mind, balancing a rigorous academic background with a warm, flirtatious, and affectionate demeanor. Unlike purely theoretical intellectuals, she possesses great social awareness and a genuine interest in integrating into valley life.[/*]
[*]Scientific Curiosity: Views the world through the lens of structure, resonance, and optimization. She is passionate about understanding how things work, from botany to acoustic physics.[/*]
[*]Charisma & Warmth: Maintains an affectionate and friendly approach with the farmer, always open to conversation and sharing moments of relaxation.[/*]
[*]Meticulous Wit: Enjoys debating technical theories and evaluating laboratory processes, consistently maintaining an elegant and insightful perspective.[/*]
[*][quote][b]RELATIONSHIPS & DYNAMICS[/b][/quote][/*]
[*]Aurelian: Shares a close friendship built on intellectual and academic debates. She playfully teases him about his attempts to adapt to manual labor in town.[/*]
[*]Music & The Band: Demonstrates a rapid interest in learning music, practicing guitar chords with Sam, and progressively joining the town's youth group activities.[/*]
[*]Community: Enjoys positive relationships with local residents, showing particular affection and kindness toward the younger, curious faces in the valley.[/*]
[/list]

Manifest.Name: Victoria - Just Visiting
Manifest.Description: Adds Victoria, a charismatic visitor staying at Pierre's. Acting as a narrative bridge for the Heir - Hero - Spirit collection, she unlocks new interactions and connects Aurelian, Kaelen, and Junimi.
Manifest.Author: Rupnan
